revisions.summary: Treat appointment as co-counsel as a meaningful position and lead the bullet with that position.
revisions.instruction: Lead with the co-counsel position itself; treat trusted participation in the matter as decision-relevant value without inventing a separate task or outcome.
must_preserve: Apollo Justice's ownership of the decisive trial
must_avoid: Requiring an unsupported deliverable or outcome
Calling the matter high-profile without evidence
Taking credit for Apollo's lead role
